site.name: Fools Paradise Number One Mine
overview: Fools Paradise Number One Mine is a named historic mine locality in Boulder County preserved on the USGS Ward 1:24,000 topographic map.

USGS-derived mapping places the mine at approximately 40.03610, -105.51333, providing a stable mine-level identification point without implying that a surviving shaft or portal has been field-verified.
moreHistory: The Ward quadrangle retains Fools Paradise Number One Mine as a named mine feature in the historic mining landscape west of Boulder.

The mapped point at approximately 40.0360975, -105.5133316 is used as the identification anchor. Fools Paradise Number Two Mine is mapped at the same published coordinate, so the point should be treated as a named mine-locality anchor rather than a field-surveyed individual opening.
